entities.name: Muhammed al-Baydhaq
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Bakr Mohammed ibn Ali al Sanhaji al-Baydhaq was a Maghribi historian mainly known as a companion of Ibn Tumart and chronicler of the Almohads. Al-Baydhaq was his nickname, because he was small in stature. He was from the tribe of Senhaja.
